manifest.title: Bloom PLM by EmbedLabs
manifest.description: Bloom PLM by EmbedLabs covers requirements, controlled documents, verification, risks, changes, defects, baselines and traceability.
manifest.changelog:
* Inline artefact references and campaign/suite topology membership.
* Results sync reports the campaigns it updated.
* Clearer API conflict and error responses.
manifest.postInstallMessage:
Open Bloom at $CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN and create your administrator account.

The instance starts with no accounts, so the first visit shows a setup screen
that asks for your name, email address and a password. It stops being reachable
the moment the account exists — nobody else can claim the instance.

Email — invitations, password resets and address changes — works only if you
enabled the Email addon for this app. Without it, the administrator you create
here is the only way in.
